final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS distinct_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg FROM status_rates), above AS (SELECT sr.avg_rate, sr.distinct_sites, o.overall_avg FROM status_rates sr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND sr.avg_rate > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_of_above_statuses, AVG(distinct_sites) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_overall_rate FROM above
